title: Competitor change intelligence output
description: Per-target monitoring reports, concise run summaries, and human-readable or machine-readable digests. Persistent baseline state is intentionally not exposed as a run-output link.

reviewCsv.title: Change review CSV
reviewCsv.description: Flattened before/after changes with percentage deltas, confidence and recommended actions. Includes diagnostic rows for targets without changes.

reports.title: Target reports
reports.description: One structured monitoring or safety-stop report per processed target.

runSummary.title: Run summary
runSummary.description: Machine-readable run counts, severity totals, baseline outcomes, and delivery status.

digestMarkdown.title: Human-readable digest
digestMarkdown.description: Concise Markdown digest of material changes and recommended review actions.

digestJson.title: Machine-readable digest
digestJson.description: Structured digest for downstream automation and AI-agent workflows.
